event_identity.occurrence_summary: A person entered a disused former school after climbing the fence and was caught removing electrical wiring; resistance occurred during the police intervention.
event_identity.same_transaction_rationale: The theft and resistance arise in one continuous intervention sequence and should be represented as one EVENT with multiple offence instances unless later evidence supports a split.
